integrity: Exact integer/symbolic transfer computation with an all-size reduction; separate exhaustive finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof. No claim of independent audit or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous degree-three open-neighbourhood majority on labelled Möbius ladders M_{2n} for integer n>=3; no basin or transient classification. The no-isolated-symbol fixed-word count predates this work. A plausible broad graph-enumeration paper on Möbius ladders was not available in full text.
title: A parity-square law for recurrent majority configurations on Möbius ladders
